description: This file defines a React component named CostsGroupedBarChart, which renders a responsive grouped bar chart illustrating costs grouped by agent, environment, or cost category. It imports React, charting components from 'recharts', utility functions for shaping data and themes, and contains component logic for rendering, styling, and handling different states like loading, error, or no data.

methods.name: CostsGroupedBarChart
methods.description: React functional component for rendering a responsive, themed, grouped bar chart displaying cost data grouped by environment or cost category.
